item.title: The Teacher Who Turned a Village Into a Classroom
item.description: Ujjwala Wadekar decided learning would never be confined to a classroom. For over 30 years, this Zilla Parishad teacher in Jalgaon has turned puncture shops into math labs and fire stations into science classrooms, shaping generations along the way.
